blocks.text: O'zbek tilida zamon, inkor va so'roq fe'lning o'ziga qo'shimcha bilan qo'shiladi: ishla**yap**man, ishla**ma**dim, ishladingiz**mi**? Ingliz tilida bu vazifani alohida so'z — **yordamchi fe'l** (auxiliary verb) bajaradi. Ular uchta: **be**, **have**, **do**. Yordamchi fe'l zamonni, shaxsni, inkorni (**not** unga qo'shiladi) va so'roqni (u egadan oldinga chiqadi) ko'rsatadi; asosiy fe'l esa faqat ma'noni beradi. Har bir zamonning o'z yordamchi fe'li bor — bu darsda ularni bir joyga yig'amiz.

**be** ikki holatda yordamchi fe'l bo'ladi. Birinchisi — `-ing` bilan, davomli zamonlarda: is working, were sleeping (→ 3 va 13-darslar). Ikkinchisi — V3 bilan, majhul nisbatda: is made, was built (→ 21–22-darslar). Ikkala holatda ham inkor — be + **not** (isn't working, wasn't built), so'roq — be egadan oldin (**Are** you working? **Was** it built ...?). Bu gaplarda **do** ishlatilmaydi.

**have / has** + V3 — Present Perfect (→ 15-dars). Inkor — **haven't / hasn't** + V3, so'roq — **Have** you ...? **Has** she ...? Qisqa javob ham have bilan: Yes, I **have**. / No, she **hasn't**. O'zbekchada bunga ko'pincha `-di` yoki `-gan` to'g'ri keladi: «tugatdim», «ko'rmaganman».
do: Present Simple va Past Simple

Present Simple va Past Simple'ning darak gapida yordamchi fe'l ko'rinmaydi: I work, she work**s**, I work**ed**, she **went**. Lekin inkor va so'roqda u paydo bo'ladi: hozirgi zamonda **do / does**, o'tgan zamonda **did** (→ 6, 7 va 12-darslar). Eng muhim qoida: do / does / did dan keyin fe'l **doim V1** — `-s` ham, `-ed` ham, V2 ham qo'shilmaydi. Nega? Chunki zamon va shaxsni endi yordamchi fe'l ko'rsatyapti: she work**s** → she **does**n't work; I **went** → I **did**n't go.

items.text: I **don't drink** coffee in the evening.

blocks.text: Qaysi yordamchi fe'l? — asosiy fe'lga qarang

To'g'ri yordamchi fe'lni tanlash uchun asosiy fe'lning shakliga qarang. `-ing` bo'lsa — **be** (am / is / are / was / were). V3 bo'lsa — Present Perfect'da **have / has**, majhul nisbatda **be**. Fe'l yolg'iz, `-ing` va V3 siz bo'lsa (Present / Past Simple) — **do / does / did**. Qisqa javobda xuddi shu yordamchi fe'l takrorlanadi (→ 40–41-darslar):
have va do — asosiy fe'l sifatida ham

**have** va **do** faqat yordamchi emas, oddiy (asosiy) fe'l ham bo'la oladi: have breakfast, have a car (→ 9-dars), do homework, do the shopping (→ 57-dars). Shunda ular Present / Past Simple'da boshqa fe'llar kabi **do / does / did** yordamida inkor va so'roq hosil qiladi: **Do** you **have** a car? I **didn't have** breakfast. Bitta gapda ikkita «do» kelishi xato emas: What **do** you **do**? — birinchisi yordamchi, ikkinchisi asosiy fe'l («nima ish qilasiz»).

items.text: We **don't have** a garden, only a balcony.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Do you are hungry?» → **Are you hungry?** (be bor joyda do kerak emas); «Did you went?» → **Did you go?**; «She doesn't works.» → **She doesn't work.**; «I'm not like coffee.» → **I don't like coffee.**; «Are you have a car?» → **Do you have a car?**; «Does she working?» → **Is she working?**; «I didn't my homework.» → **I didn't do my homework.** (asosiy fe'l do tushib qolmaydi).

Eslab qolish: `-ing` → **be**; have + V3 → **have**; be + V3 (majhul) → **be**; yolg'iz fe'l → **do / does / did**. Gapda zamonni faqat bitta so'z oladi — yordamchi fe'l. Shuning uchun «Did you went?» da zamon ikki marta ko'rsatilgan — bu xato.
Yordamchi fe'llar keyingi darslarda ham kerak bo'ladi: qisqa javoblar va so'roq qo'shimchalari — 40–41-darslar, inkor gaplar — 43-dars, savollar — 44-dars.

examples.title: **be** + -ing: continuous tenses
examples.description: **be** (am / is / are / was / were) + `-ing` — davomli zamonlar (→ 3, 13-darslar). Inkor va so'roq ham be bilan: **isn't working**, **Were** you **sleeping**?

sentences.text: **Is** it still **raining** outside? — No, it's stopped.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida hali ham yomg'ir **yog'yaptimi**? — Yo'q, to'xtadi.

sentences.text: Madina **isn't working** today because she's got a cold.
sentences.translation: Madina bugun **ishlamayapti**, chunki shamollab qolgan.

sentences.text: What **were** you **doing** at eight o'clock last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha soat sakkizda nima **qilayotgan edingiz**?

sentences.text: We **weren't sleeping** when you called — we were watching a film.
sentences.translation: Siz qo'ng'iroq qilganingizda **uxlamayotgan edik** — film ko'rayotgan edik.

sentences.text: **Are** your cousins from Fergana **staying** at your place this month?
sentences.translation: Farg'onalik amakivachchalaringiz shu oy sizlarnikida **turishibdimi**?

sentences.text: The baby **was crying** all night, so nobody slept.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq tun bo'yi **yig'lab chiqdi**, shuning uchun hech kim uxlamadi.

sentences.text: Why **are** you **wearing** a coat? It's thirty degrees!
sentences.translation: Nega palto **kiyib olgansiz**? Havo o'ttiz daraja-ku!

sentences.text: Tom **wasn't listening**, so he didn't hear the question.
sentences.translation: Tom **quloq solmayotgan edi**, shuning uchun savolni eshitmadi.

sentences.text: Look! The children **are building** a snowman in the garden.
sentences.translation: Qarang! Bolalar bog'da qor odam **yasashyapti**.

sentences.text: While I **was cooking**, my husband **was laying** the table.
sentences.translation: Men ovqat **pishirayotganimda**, erim dasturxon **yozayotgan edi**.

examples.title: **be** + V3: the passive
examples.description: **be** + V3 — majhul nisbat (→ 21–22-darslar). Bu yerda ham inkor va so'roq be bilan, do / did emas: **Was** it **made** ...? It **isn't used**.

sentences.text: This car **was made** in Germany in 2010.
sentences.translation: Bu mashina 2010-yilda Germaniyada **ishlab chiqarilgan**.

sentences.text: **Is** Uzbek **taught** at your university? — Yes, it is.
sentences.translation: Universitetingizda o'zbek tili **o'qitiladimi**? — Ha, o'qitiladi.

sentences.text: Our flat **was painted** last month, and it looks great.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramiz o'tgan oy **bo'yaldi**, juda chiroyli ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: These rooms **aren't used** in winter because they're too cold.
sentences.translation: Bu xonalar qishda **ishlatilmaydi**, chunki ular juda sovuq.

sentences.text: Where **were** these photos **taken**? — In Khiva, last summer.
sentences.translation: Bu suratlar qayerda **olingan**? — Xivada, o'tgan yozda.

sentences.text: The match **wasn't shown** on TV, so we listened to it on the radio.
sentences.translation: O'yin televizorda **ko'rsatilmadi**, shuning uchun uni radioda eshitdik.

sentences.text: Sorry, this table **is** already **booked** for eight o'clock.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu stol soat sakkizga allaqachon **band qilingan**.

sentences.text: **Were** the children **told** about the trip? — Not yet.
sentences.translation: Bolalarga sayohat haqida **aytildimi**? — Hali yo'q.

sentences.text: In many countries, the main meal **is eaten** in the evening.
sentences.translation: Ko'p mamlakatlarda asosiy ovqat kechqurun **yeyiladi**.

sentences.text: The museum **is being cleaned**, so it's closed to visitors this week.
sentences.translation: Muzey **tozalanyapti**, shuning uchun bu hafta tashrif buyuruvchilar uchun yopiq.

examples.title: **have / has** + V3: present perfect
examples.description: **have / has** + V3 — Present Perfect (→ 15–18-darslar). Inkor: **haven't / hasn't**, so'roq: **Have** you ...? **Has** she ...?

sentences.text: **I've** already **booked** the hotel in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Buxorodagi mehmonxonani allaqachon **band qildim**.

sentences.text: **Has** Bekzod **finished** his project yet? — Yes, he has.
sentences.translation: Bekzod loyihasini **tugatdimi**? — Ha, tugatdi.

sentences.text: We **haven't seen** our cousins from Andijan for a long time.
sentences.translation: Andijonlik amakivachchalarimizni ancha vaqtdan beri **ko'rmaganmiz**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **met** our new neighbours from Leeds? — Not yet.
sentences.translation: Lidslik yangi qo'shnilarimiz bilan **tanishdingizmi**? — Hali yo'q.

sentences.text: Emma **has lost** her keys again, so she's waiting outside.
sentences.translation: Emma yana kalitlarini **yo'qotib qo'ydi**, shuning uchun tashqarida kutyapti.

sentences.text: The price of bread **has gone** up twice this year.
sentences.translation: Bu yil non narxi ikki marta **oshdi**.

sentences.text: How long **have** you **lived** in this flat? — For six years.
sentences.translation: Bu kvartirada qancha vaqtdan beri **yashaysiz**? — Olti yildan beri.

sentences.text: My grandparents **have** never **flown**, so they're nervous about the trip.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim hech qachon samolyotda **uchmagan**, shuning uchun safardan xavotirda.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **haven't read** your message yet — I was driving.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, xabaringizni hali **o'qimadim** — mashina haydayotgan edim.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has** just **passed** her driving test, and she's very happy.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **hozirgina** haydovchilik imtihonidan **o'tdi**, juda xursand.

examples.title: **do / does**: present simple negatives and questions
examples.description: Present Simple darak gapida yordamchi fe'l ko'rinmaydi (I work, she works), lekin inkor va so'roqda **do / does** kerak. Undan keyin fe'l — doim V1: **Does** she **work**? She **doesn't work**.

sentences.text: **Do** you **speak** any other languages? — Yes, Russian and a little Korean.
sentences.translation: Boshqa tillarda **gaplashasizmi**? — Ha, ruscha va biroz koreyscha.

sentences.text: My brother **doesn't eat** meat, but he loves fish.
sentences.translation: Akam go'sht **yemaydi**, lekin baliqni juda yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: **Does** this bus **go** to the city centre? — No, it doesn't.
sentences.translation: Bu avtobus shahar markaziga **boradimi**? — Yo'q, bormaydi.

sentences.text: Where **does** your sister **work**? — At a bank in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Opangiz qayerda **ishlaydi**? — Manchesterdagi bankda.

sentences.text: We **don't watch** TV very often — we prefer books.
sentences.translation: Biz televizorni tez-tez **ko'rmaymiz** — kitobni afzal ko'ramiz.

sentences.text: How often **do** you **visit** your grandparents in the village?
sentences.translation: Qishloqdagi bobo-buvingiznikiga qanchalik tez-tez **borasiz**?

sentences.text: Sarah **doesn't drive**, so she cycles to work every day.
sentences.translation: Sara mashina **haydamaydi**, shuning uchun har kuni ishga velosipedda boradi.

sentences.text: What time **do** the shops **open** on Sundays?
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kunlari do'konlar soat nechada **ochiladi**?

sentences.text: **Does** your son **like** his new school? — Yes, he does, very much.
sentences.translation: O'g'lingizga yangi maktabi **yoqyaptimi**? — Ha, juda yoqyapti.

sentences.text: I **don't understand** this word — what **does** it **mean**?
sentences.translation: Bu so'zni **tushunmayapman** — u nimani **anglatadi**?

examples.title: **did**: past simple negatives and questions
examples.description: Past Simple darak gapida fe'l V2 shaklida (worked, went), inkor va so'roqda esa **did** + V1: I **didn't go**, **Did** you **see** ...? O'tgan zamonni did ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun fe'l V1 da qoladi.

sentences.text: **Did** you **sleep** well last night? — Not really, it was too hot.
sentences.translation: Kecha yaxshi **uxladingizmi**? — Unchalik emas, juda issiq edi.

sentences.text: I **didn't buy** anything at the market — everything was too expensive.
sentences.translation: Bozordan hech narsa **olmadim** — hammasi juda qimmat edi.

sentences.text: When **did** Aziz **come** back from Moscow? — On Sunday.
sentences.translation: Aziz Moskvadan qachon **qaytdi**? — Yakshanba kuni.

sentences.text: Our team **didn't win**, but we played well.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz **yutmadi**, lekin yaxshi o'ynadik.

sentences.text: **Did** your parents **enjoy** the trip to Oxford?
sentences.translation: Ota-onangizga Oksfordga safar **yoqdimi**?

sentences.text: Why **didn't** you **tell** me about the exam? I **didn't know**!
sentences.translation: Imtihon haqida menga nega **aytmadingiz**? Men **bilmasdim**-ku!

sentences.text: Where **did** you **get** that jacket? It looks great.
sentences.translation: Bu kurtkani qayerdan **oldingiz**? Juda chiroyli ekan.

sentences.text: James **didn't hear** his alarm, so he was late for work.
sentences.translation: Jeyms budilnikni **eshitmadi**, shuning uchun ishga kechikdi.

sentences.text: What **did** the doctor **say** about your leg?
sentences.translation: Shifokor oyog'ingiz haqida nima **dedi**?

sentences.text: Last year we **didn't go** on holiday because we were saving money for a car.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili ta'tilga **chiqmadik**, chunki mashina uchun pul yig'ayotgan edik.

examples.title: **have** and **do** as main verbs
examples.description: **have** va **do** asosiy fe'l ham bo'la oladi: have breakfast, do homework. Unda Simple zamonlarda ular ham **do / does / did** bilan ishlaydi: **Did** you **do** ...? I **didn't have** ... Bir gapda ikkita «do» — oddiy hol.

sentences.text: **Did** you **do** your homework last night? — Yes, I did.
sentences.translation: Kecha uy vazifangizni **qildingizmi**? — Ha, qildim.

sentences.text: I **didn't have** time for breakfast this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab nonushtaga **vaqtim bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: What **do** you **do**? — I'm a nurse at a children's hospital.
sentences.translation: **Kasbingiz nima**? — Bolalar shifoxonasida hamshiraman.

sentences.text: **Does** your flat **have** a balcony? — No, it doesn't.
sentences.translation: Kvartirangizda **balkon bormi**? — Yo'q, balkon yo'q.

sentences.text: Madina **does** the shopping on Saturdays, and her husband **does** the cooking.
sentences.translation: Shanba kunlari Madina bozor-o'char **qiladi**, eri esa ovqat **pishiradi**.

sentences.text: We **didn't do** anything special at the weekend — we just stayed at home.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari maxsus hech narsa **qilmadik** — shunchaki uyda qoldik.

sentences.text: **Have** you **had** lunch yet? — Yes, I've just eaten.
sentences.translation: Tushlik **qildingizmi**? — Ha, hozirgina ovqatlandim.

sentences.text: Tom **doesn't have** a car, so he usually takes the train.
sentences.translation: Tomning **mashinasi yo'q**, shuning uchun u odatda poyezdda yuradi.

sentences.text: What **did** you **do** with my umbrella? It isn't in the hall.
sentences.translation: Soyabonimni nima **qildingiz**? U dahlizda yo'q.

sentences.text: My father **has done** the same job for thirty years, and he **has** never **had** a holiday abroad.
sentences.translation: Otam o'ttiz yildan beri bir ishda **ishlaydi** va hech qachon chet elda **dam olmagan**.

examples.title: Which auxiliary? Questions and short answers
examples.description: Qaysi yordamchi fe'l kerakligini asosiy fe'l ko'rsatadi: `-ing` → be, V3 (Present Perfect) → have, yolg'iz fe'l → do / does / did. Qisqa javobda ham shu yordamchi fe'l takrorlanadi.

sentences.text: **Are** you **listening** to me? — Yes, I **am**!
sentences.translation: Meni **eshityapsizmi**? — Ha, eshityapman!

sentences.text: **Do** you **know** Bekzod's brother? — No, I **don't**.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning akasini **taniysizmi**? — Yo'q, tanimayman.

sentences.text: **Have** you **finished** your coffee? — Yes, I **have**.
sentences.translation: Qahvangizni **ichib bo'ldingizmi**? — Ha, ichib bo'ldim.

sentences.text: **Did** Emma **reply** to your email? — No, she **didn't**.
sentences.translation: Emma xatingizga **javob berdimi**? — Yo'q, bermadi.

sentences.text: **Was** it **snowing** when you left Samarkand? — Yes, it **was**.
sentences.translation: Samarqanddan chiqqaningizda qor **yog'ayotgan edimi**? — Ha, yog'ayotgan edi.

sentences.text: **Is** this room **cleaned** every day? — Yes, it **is**.
sentences.translation: Bu xona har kuni **tozalanadimi**? — Ha, tozalanadi.

sentences.text: **Does** Dilnoza **play** the piano? — Yes, she **does**, and she sings too.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza pianino **chaladimi**? — Ha, chaladi, qo'shiq ham aytadi.

sentences.text: **Has** the shop **opened** yet? — No, it **hasn't**. It opens at ten.
sentences.translation: Do'kon **ochildimi**? — Yo'q, hali ochilmadi. U soat o'nda ochiladi.

sentences.text: **Were** you **born** in Tashkent? — No, I **wasn't**. I was born in Jizzakh.
sentences.translation: Siz Toshkentda **tug'ilganmisiz**? — Yo'q. Men Jizzaxda tug'ilganman.

sentences.text: **Did** the children **have** a good time at the zoo? — Yes, they **did**!
sentences.translation: Bolalar hayvonot bog'ida **maza qilishdimi**? — Ha, juda!

examples.title: Mixed practice: not this, but that
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: inkor ↔ tasdiq turli yordamchi fe'llar bilan. Har bir gapda avval zamonni aniqlang, keyin yordamchi fe'lni tanlang.

sentences.text: Aziz **isn't sleeping** — he**'s reading** in his room.
sentences.translation: Aziz **uxlamayapti** — xonasida kitob **o'qiyapti**.

sentences.text: I **didn't forget** your birthday — I just **didn't have** time to call.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kuningizni **unutmadim** — shunchaki qo'ng'iroq qilishga **vaqtim bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: The tickets **weren't sold** online; they **were sold** at the door.
sentences.translation: Chiptalar internetda **sotilmadi**, ular kiraverishda **sotildi**.

sentences.text: My sister **doesn't live** in London any more — she **moved** to Bristol last year.
sentences.translation: Opam endi Londonda **yashamaydi** — u o'tgan yili Bristolga **ko'chib ketdi**.

sentences.text: We **haven't decided** yet, but we**'re thinking** about a holiday in Turkey.
sentences.translation: Hali **qaror qilmadik**, lekin Turkiyada dam olish haqida **o'ylayapmiz**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **wasn't laughing** at you — I **was laughing** at the cat.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, men sizning ustingizdan **kulmayotgan edim** — mushukka **kulayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: James **has** never **been** to Uzbekistan, but he **knows** a lot about it.
sentences.translation: Jeyms O'zbekistonda hech qachon **bo'lmagan**, lekin u haqida ko'p narsa **biladi**.

sentences.text: **Does** your father still **work** at the factory? — No, he **retired** in 2020.
sentences.translation: Otangiz hali ham zavodda **ishlaydimi**? — Yo'q, 2020-yilda **nafaqaga chiqdi**.

sentences.text: The window **wasn't broken** by the wind — the children **broke** it with a ball.
sentences.translation: Derazani shamol **sindirmagan** — uni bolalar to'p bilan **sindirishgan**.

sentences.text: When I phoned Madina, she **wasn't cooking** — she **was doing** her homework.
sentences.translation: Madinaga qo'ng'iroq qilganimda, u ovqat **pishirayotgan emas edi** — uy vazifasini **qilayotgan edi**.
